title: Native contraction before the compositor cancellation
statement: At either native site and any finite commutative coefficient ring, for composable compactifiable quasi-compact f and g, install the published derived braidings and use the existing CompositeIntegrationData [def-pur-composite-integration-operations]. For every permitted K, put L=Lf tensor Pf Lg. The transported actual composite counit equals Fgf(beta(Pgf K,L)), then Fgf(L tensor pullComp_K inverse), then alpha_(L tensor Pf Pg K) inverse, then Fg(qf(L,Pg K)), then qg(Ff L,K), then (Fg(qf(Lf,Lg)) followed by Fg(tf tensor Lg), Fg(lambda_Lg), tg) tensor identity_K, then lambda_K. This is the explicitly typed PrecompositorContraction identity. It does not use projection_comp or any projection map of fg.
